text:
Olivia Chen: hi all :wave: I followed the k8s onboarding guide but I can't see the staging context. `kubectl config get-contexts` only shows `redwood-dev` and `redwood-prod`. on mac M1. any obvious miss?

DevEx Bot: welcome Olivia! tagging @Sam Kim. Quick checks: run `echo $KUBECONFIG` and `kubectl config get-contexts -o name`. Also confirm whether you used AWS SSO during setup.

Sam Kim: staging cluster is `redwood-staging-us-west-2`. Two likely causes: multiple kubeconfig files not merged, or SSO creds not fetched. Can you paste outputs?

Olivia Chen: sure:
```
$ kubectl config get-contexts -o name
redwood-dev
redwood-prod
```
`$ echo $KUBECONFIG`
`/Users/olivia/.kube/config:/Users/olivia/.kube/config-aws`

Olivia Chen: also `kubectl get ns` lists dev/prod namespaces but no `staging`.

Priya Rao: that confirms it: multiple kubeconfigs. Try `KUBECONFIG=/Users/olivia/.kube/config-aws kubectl config get-contexts -o name` to check if `redwood-staging-us-west-2` is present. If so merge: `kubectl config view --flatten > ~/.kube/merged-config` then `export KUBECONFIG=~/.kube/merged-config` (or replace `~/.kube/config` after backup).

Sam Kim: if you use AWS SSO, do `aws sso login --profile redwood` then `aws eks update-kubeconfig --name redwood-staging --region us-west-2 --profile redwood`. If you see the context but get Forbidden on `kubectl get pods -n staging`, we'll need to add an RBAC binding.

Olivia Chen: ran the SSO login and update, now `redwood-staging-us-west-2` is in contexts but `kubectl get pods -n staging` gives `Error from server (Forbidden): pods is forbidden: User \"arn:aws:iam::1234567890:role/Redwood-SSO-Redwood\" cannot list resource \"pods\" in the namespace \"staging\"`.

Priya Rao: RBAC issue — your IAM principal isn't bound to a k8s Role/ClusterRole for that namespace. Sam can create a short-lived RoleBinding granting `view` on `staging` to your principal or to the `redwood-engineers` group.

Sam Kim: Olivia, can you DM me your company email so I can apply the RoleBinding?

Olivia Chen: olivia.chen@redwood.example.com

Sam Kim: applied RoleBinding `rb-olivia-staging-view` in `staging` (bound to `redwood-engineers` group and your principal). Try `kubectl auth can-i list pods -n staging` then `kubectl get pods -n staging`.

Olivia Chen: `kubectl auth can-i list pods -n staging` -> `yes`
`kubectl get pods -n staging` now shows pods :tada:

Olivia Chen: thanks! I'll add a short troubleshooting note to the onboarding doc about `KUBECONFIG` ordering and the `aws sso` + `update-kubeconfig` step.

Priya Rao: please do — this comes up often, so a one-liner in the guide will help new hires. :+1:

DevEx Bot: noted: adding a pointer about `KUBECONFIG` merging and AWS SSO steps to the onboarding doc in the next PR. Thanks for the report!
